name: netintel
description: Pay-per-call network, domain, web and inference lookups for agents — DNS, SSL, WHOIS, IP reputation, email verification, web fetch & search, OpenAI-compatible gateway, embeddings, market data — paid per call in USDC over x402. No API keys.

evm_private_key.title: Agent wallet private key (Base)
evm_private_key.description: Optional. Private key (0x…) of a dedicated agent wallet holding USDC on Base mainnet; each paid tool call pays its listed price from it (gasless). Leave empty to start wallet-less: DNS, SSL, WHOIS, subnet and email-auth tools work free up to a quota, and paid tools explain how to fund. Stored in secure storage.
